body.x: Korea McNulty introduced coffee beans and instant coffee at Korea Electronics Show 2016, which ran Oct. 26-29 at COEX.

It introduced its office coffee system(OCS) rental program. It has number one market share in coffee bean market, and it supplies coffee beans from all over the world at reasonable prices. It has almost all kinds of coffee, from coffee beans and instant coffee.
Its major products are IBrew and Alejandro World Barista, all supplied in high quality.

Hosted by MOTIE and organized by KEA, KES 2016 is the major international electronics and IT trade show in Korea where the convergence solution in the leading fields like electronics, ICT, semiconductors, and display and industry and IT convergence, digital broadcasting, smart education, smart factory, and e-health is displayed.
